name: Wick Wisp
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A tiny candle flame that drifts in a wavy line and bumps you. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#183). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
senseiLine: Little lights get lost too. Help it find its glow.
description: A tiny candle flame that drifts in a wavy line and bumps you.

bestiary.tip: Punch it, or COUNTER the bump.

lore.white: When the lamps went dim, this little flame drifted off and lost its way. Calm it, and it glows warm again.
